context: A couple plans a road trip and discusses gas prices
purpose: Teach: まずい/済む/貼り/カタログ/デート/ガソリン/返す/願う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえお父さん、彼と来週デートで海までドライブしたいんだけど、車貸してくれない?
lines.en: Hey Dad, I want to drive to the ocean with him on our date next week — can I borrow the car?
lines.style: Sweet coaxing daughter voice, slightly playful, rising hopeful tone at the end.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 海までか。最近ガソリン代が高くて、ちょっとまずいんだよなあ。
lines.en: All the way to the ocean, huh. Gas prices have been high lately — it's a bit rough.
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone with a thoughtful sigh, mild concern, slightly lower register.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、満タンで済むくらいなら出すよ?どれくらいかかるの?
lines.en: Eh, if one full tank is enough I'll cover it — about how much would it cost?
lines.style: Surprised girlish reaction, leaning in with genuine curiosity, slight pleading lilt.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 片道なら一回の給油で済むけど、往復だと二回は入れないと足りないな。
lines.en: One way's enough on a single fill-up, but round trip you'll need to refuel twice.
lines.style: Calm calculating voice, practical and measured, gentle and instructive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、冷蔵庫に貼ってあった燃費のいい車のカタログ、あれ参考になるかな?
lines.en: Oh, that car catalog with good mileage you stuck on the fridge — would that help?
lines.style: Bright problem-solving tone, cheerful and cooperative, brightening mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、あのカタログな。次の車の参考にしようと貼り付けといたんだ。
lines.en: Ah, that catalog. I stuck it up there for reference when we get the next car.
lines.style: Nostalgic relaxed dad voice, slight chuckle, warm and reminiscent.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあ給油代はちゃんと返すから、貸してくれるとすごく嬉しいな。
lines.en: Then I'll pay you back for the gas properly, so I'd be really happy if you'd lend it to me.
lines.style: Tender coaxing tone, soft and sincere, affectionate daughter charm throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: わかったよ。安全運転で、無事に帰ってきてくれることを願うばかりだ。
lines.en: Alright. I just hope you drive safely and come back home in one piece.
lines.style: Resolved fatherly voice, gentle smile audible, reassuring and protective tone.
